title: Power Tokens
body: Power Tokens provide token items which can be used to gain positive and negative powers. This creates a fun and new way to play Minecraft. **Press [V] to open up a list of your powers.** # Powers Powers are random passive effects you have that are permentant till you wipe them with a **Inverted Token**. They are split into two categories: buffs and debuffs. ### Buffs * **More Health** - Gain 5 more hearts. * **Speed Boost** - Gain a 60% speed boost. * **Tiny** - Become 50% smaller. * **Natural Armor** - Gain a passive 2.5 armor points * **Miner Training** - Mine 100% faster. * **Swift Hands** - Attacks take less time to charge up. * **Less Knockback** - Attacks deal 50% less knockback. * **Lung Capacity** - You have more air while under water. ### Debuffs * **Less Health** - Loose 5 hearts. * **Flammable** - Burn for longer. * **Weakened Defenses** - Passively loose 2.5 armor points. * **More Knockback** - Deal 50% more knockback. * **Heavy Hands** - Attacks take more time to charge up. * **Less Damage** - Deal less damage. * **Big** - Become 30% bigger. * **Less Speed** - Become 30% slower. * **Metal Bones** - Take fall damage 1 block earlier. * **Aquaphobic** - Take damage while touching water. * **Vampire** - Burn when in broad daylight. # Power Tokens To gain a power you must first craft one of the power tokens. There are three different types of power tokens. * **Unstable Token** - Cheapest, however provides two debuff powers for a random buff power. * **Power Token** - Provides a random buff power alongside a random debuff power. * **Reinforced Token** - Provides a random buff power only. * **Selective Token** - Allows you to pick one power. ## Reseting You may be unsatisfied with your debuffs, so you can craft an **Inverted Token**. to remove all your powers. However, this includes all your buffs.
